subjects.observationMode: Full-size manual visual inspection, not automatic semantic inference
subjects.eyeObservation: One clear near eye. The far eye cannot be located confidently from this painted view; no far-eye coordinate or pixel owner is invented.

subjects.name: Cuttlefish
subjects.observationMode: Full-size manual visual inspection, not automatic semantic inference
subjects.eyeObservation: One clear eye; far eye is not confidently visible.
subjects.appendageObservation: Two long club-ended feeding tentacles are distinct. Short arm roots/tips overlap; this observation does not assert a complete count or invent endpoints.

contractFinding: The cephalopod graph requires eyeFar and eyeNear unless the complete eyes group is explicitly absent. Hidden presence currently supports only brachyuran leg3 chains. A hidden far eye cannot honestly be represented as absent eyes or as a fabricated painted landmark.
decision: Do not hand-author a false reference from these views. Future source repaint should expose both eyes and a traceable full appendage inventory; runtime hidden-eye support, if separately implemented, would change product bytes and require later evidence.
